// diagnostic

E0113

This value is String (text), but `name` returns Int

What

This value is String (text), but `name` returns Int

Why

A written return type is the function's contract, so the value it hands back must have that type

Fix

Convert or reshape the value into the declared type (for example `/%` for whole-number division, `[value]` for a list, `"{value}"` for text); the declared return type stays as written

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0113: tests/ui/E0113_int_narrowing_result.stderr.

Error [jet.ReturnTypeMismatch]: This value is Int (a whole number), but `low_byte` returns U8
  --> tests/ui/E0113_int_narrowing_result.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     n
    |     ^
 Why: `low_byte` declares U8 as its result, so the value it hands back must be U8
 Fix: Convert it with `U8.from_int(value) ?? fallback`; the conversion is `None` when the value doesn't fit in U8
